title: Get Live Room View Trends
label: TIKTOK SHOP · API REFERENCE
subtitle: Updated 2026-10-13
html:
Path: /analytics/202502/live_rooms/{live_room_id}/view_trend_performances

Method: [GET]

Function Description

Returns viewer count trend data points for the specified live room, grouped by online, entering, and leaving viewers.

Common Parameters

For common parameters, refer to How to call TikTok Shop APIs - Common Parameters

Properties Location Type Require Sample Properties description
content-type header string Y application/json Allowed type: application/json

Request Path Parameters

Properties Type Require Sample Properties description
live_room_id string Y 7274599999999999999 The ID of the live streaming room whose viewer trend data is requested. The live room must be associated with the authorized creator.

Request Query Parameters

Properties Type Require Sample Properties description
app_key string Y 38abcd Every single app will have a unique key. Please use the specific key assigned to your app.
sign string Y 5361235029d141222525e303d742f9e38aea052d10896d3197ab9d6233730b8c Signature generated by gen algorithm. When you send API requests to TTS, you must sign them so that TTS can identify the senders.
timestamp int Y 1623812664 Unix timestamp GMT (UTC+00:00). This timestamp is used across all API requests. Developers can use this convert to local time.

Request Sample

Query

https://open-api.tiktokglobalshop.com/analytics/202502/live_rooms/7274599999999999999/view_trend_performances?app_key=123abc&sign=5361235029d141222525e303d742f9e38aea052d10896d3197ab9d6233730b8c&timestamp=1625484268

Response Parameters

Properties Type Sample Properties description
code int 0 The success or failure status code returned in API response.
message string Success The success or failure messages returned in API response. Reasons of failure will be described in the message.
request_id string 202203070749000101890810281E8C70B7 Request log
data object Specific return information
^view_trend_performances []object Viewer count trends of the live streaming room
^^stats_type string TREND_ONLINE_VIEWER The viewer trend category.
TREND_ONLINE_VIEWER: Viewers who are watching the live streaming room.
TREND_ENTER_VIEWER: Viewers who enter the live streaming room.
TREND_LEFT_VIEWER: Viewers who left the live streaming room.
^^data_points []object Viewer count data points for the corresponding trend category.
^^^value string 123 The viewer count for the corresponding trend category at this data point.
^^^timestamp int 1623812664 The Unix timestamp of the viewer count data point, in seconds, in UTC.

Response Sample

{"code":0,"data":{"view_trend_performances":[{"stats_type":"TREND_ONLINE_VIEWER","data_points":[{"value":"123","timestamp":1623812664}]}]},"message":"Success","request_id":"202203070749000101890810281E8C70B7"}
